tools.name: dpu-diag
tools.stdout_snippet:
NAME
        dpu-diag - Diagnose UPMEM SDK

SYNOPSIS
        dpu-diag [options]

DESCRIPTION
        Without option, dpu-diag verifies that everything from the SDK and the runtime is installed and working.

OPTIONS
        --sram-gen-vpd  Detect SRAM defects and produce a list in a file. By default, the files are stored
                        in /usr/share/upmem/dimm-quirks, with files named after the DIMM serial number,
                        ie UPM<serial_num>.vpd

        --extensive-check
                        Extensive detection of SRAM defects using a DPU program. This option is incompatible
                        with --vpd-dir as VPD files will be searched in /usr/share/upmem/dimm-quirks

        -f, --force     Force creation of vpd from scratch, without reading existing one.

        --color         Force colorize the output

        -h, --help      Print this help and exit
